findings: Make BusinessContextFact a frozen runtime-valid value boundary: name, value, and source_reference must each be non-empty strings after trimming; empty, whitespace-only, or non-string values fail deterministically without defaults or inference.

Enforce canonical snapshot integrity in FindingAssetBusinessContextUseCase. The AssetBusinessContext returned for a resolved FindingAssetContext must have the exact same canonical_asset_id; any asset-1 versus different-asset mismatch raises a controlled dedicated integrity error and never returns RESOLVED.

Complete BusinessImpactReadiness with finding_id and the existing core.explainability.ExplanationCompleteness/ExplanationProvenance authority. READY requires exact required facts, empty missing requirements, complete fact/source provenance, AVAILABLE completeness, and deterministic business_impact_readiness result provenance. UNAVAILABLE preserves exact missing requirements and any valid partial facts/provenance, and cannot claim AVAILABLE completeness.

Extend API serialization with readiness finding identity, exact facts, source records, completeness status, source type, and source reference; resolved business context retains per-fact provenance. Frontend parsing rejects incomplete, contradictory, unknown, or provenance-free READY payloads and rendering explicitly states that no Business Impact was calculated.

Add the focused construction, canonical mismatch, provenance, API, parser, rendering, DistCC, and TASK-0127/TASK-0128 regression tests specified in READY TASK-0129. Keep business_impact null and do not add impact calculation, legacy/Decision/Recommendation, Risk Manager/Executive/mock, AI/provider, severity/priority/TI/exposure/CVSS/EPSS/KEV inference, DONE transition, or TASK-0130.
